messages:
maria: Starting canary lift to 10% now, within the 10:00-11:00 UTC change window. Deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-23-10. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started — deploy-2026-03-23 at 10:02 UTC. Canary target: 10% across us-west/us-east. Rollout policy: gradual 0->10 over 5m. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23

aj: Noticing a small uptick in 5xxs on the embed route at 10:05. 5xx rate from 0.1% -> 0.9% over 2m :eyes: Dashboard: https://dash.re/metrics/embed

maria: @aj thanks — can you paste the graph? Is this client-side or server-side?

aj: quick snapshot: ```
> embed_latency_p75: 230ms -> 940ms
> embed_5xx_count: 12 -> 98
```
Looks infra-ish, but not sure. Holding further percent until we confirm.

sanjay: infra check: pod count stable, no node OOMs. However KV cache evictions spiked concurrent with 10% shift. Evictions from 2/min -> 120/min. Might be KV cache pressure from longer sequences.

hannah: If evictions are the culprit, do we want to rollback to previous model build (v2.3.1) and pin there while we investigate? Change window still open for ~45m.

maria: I'd prefer a pause at 10% and pin the version if signals don't improve in 5m. @deploy-bot can you pin deploy-2026-03-23 to rollback target v2.3.1 if we vote?

deploy-bot: reaction: :thumbsup: — Available actions: `pause`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`. To execute, run `/deploy action <action>` in this thread.

aj: vote: rollback. Spike looks correlated with new tokenization path. We saw similar pattern in staging once.

sanjay: vote: hold + investigation 5m. If evictions persist, rollback.

hannah: vote: rollback to v2.3.1 and pin until fix is validated.

maria: consensus seems rollback. I'm going to trigger a safe rollback to v2.3.1 now. Notifying support channels.

maria: `/deploy rollback --to v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23 --reason "canary 10% spike kv-evictions"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deploy-2026-03-23. Rolling back 100% of canary traffic to v2.3.1. ETA ~2m. Notifying infra and monitoring.

aj: seeing error rate drop in the last 90s, p75 latency coming down. Nice.

sanjay: infra confirms KV evictions falling back to baseline. We'll open a postmortem ticket and capture traces.

hannah: pushing short release note addendum: "Rolled back canary deploy-2026-03-23 due to KV cache pressure; investigating tokenizer path impact." Will update release notes page and customer comms if needed.

maria: thanks all. Pinning v2.3.1 for the change window. /deploy pin --version v2.3.1

deploy-bot: version v2.3.1 pinned for change window until 2026-03-23T11:00:00Z. Incident ticket: INC-2026-142 opened by deploy-bot.

aj: :thumbsup: I'll run the quick bisect on the tokenizer change and share findings in INC-2026-142.

maria: meeting note: quick stop/go call concluded. Outcome: hold at 10% then rollback + pin. Follow-ups in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

hannah: adding follow-up owner @sanjay for infra tweaks and @aj for regression test.

maria: closing thread. Thanks everyone.
